tools.name: create_deliberation
tools.description:
Start a multi-model AI deliberation on a question or decision.

Runs the prompt through multiple frontier AI models in parallel and collects each model's typed reactions (KEEP/EXPLORE/CHALLENGE/CORE/SHIFT) to the others' claims, showing where they agree and diverge.

**Returns immediately (async).**

tools.description:

tools.name: get_session
tools.description:
Fetch a deliberation session: every visible round (its reacted-to claims grouped as Contested, Open, Pivotal and Kept, the takeaway when one was requested, then the responses), followed by the session details.

Use to re-read completed session state. While a round is running, prefer `wait_for_round`

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description:
List the caller's deliberation sessions, optionally filtered by status.

Most useful for agents managing multiple concurrent sessions — use `status: 'ready'` to find sessions awaiting your next round. Returns a lightweight list (no response bodies); call `get_session` for full content.

tools.description: List the full model catalog, sorted by what your account can use: available on your plan, available on a higher plan, and unavailable right now (with the reason). findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "append_round" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never, attention). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_deliberation, append_round, wait_for_round, get_session, share_session, get_credit · Private data: list_models, share_session, get_credit · Public sink: ask_a_model, append_round, get_session, share_session, get_credit · Destructive: create_deliberation, wait_for_round.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_deliberation, append_round, wait_for_round, get_session, share_session, get_credit · Private data: list_models, share_session, get_credit · Public sink: ask_a_model, append_round, get_session, share_session, get_credit · Destructive: create_deliberation, wait_for_round

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ask_a_model" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
